Akabeko.name: Akabeko
Akabeko.text: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{VigorPower}[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold].
Akabeko.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{VigorPower}[/blue]点[gold]活力[/gold]。

AlchemicalCoffer.name: Alchemical Coffer
AlchemicalCoffer.text: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion slots filled with random potions.
AlchemicalCoffer.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue]个放有随机药水的药水栏位。

Anchor.name: Anchor
Anchor.text_zh: 每场战斗开始时获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ArcaneScroll.name: Arcane Scroll
ArcaneScroll.text: Upon pickup, obtain a random [gold]Rare Card[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ArcaneScroll.text_zh: 拾起时，将一张随机[gold]稀有牌[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

ArchaicTooth.name: Archaic Tooth
ArchaicTooth.text: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] {StarterCard.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterCard}[/gold] into [gold]{AncientCard}[/gold]|a starter card into an ancient version}.
ArchaicTooth.text_zh: 拾起时，将{StarterCard.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterCard}[/gold][gold]变化[/gold]为[gold]{AncientCard}[/gold]|一张初始卡牌[gold]变化[/gold]为先古版本}。

ArtOfWar.name: Art of War
ArtOfWar.text: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
ArtOfWar.text_zh: 如果你在本回合中没有打出过攻击牌，则在下一回合额外获得1点{Energy:energyIcons()}。

Astrolabe.name: Astrolabe
Astrolabe.text_zh: 拾起时，选择[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌进行[gold]变化[/gold]，然后将这些牌[gold]升级[/gold]。

BagOfMarbles.name: Bag of Marbles
BagOfMarbles.text: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BagOfMarbles.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人[blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

BagOfPreparation.name: Bag of Preparation
BagOfPreparation.text: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BagOfPreparation.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

BeatingRemnant.name: Beating Remnant
BeatingRemnant.text: You cannot lose more than [blue]20[/blue] HP in a single turn.
BeatingRemnant.text_zh: 你在一回合内失去的生命值不会超过[blue]20[/blue]点。

BeautifulBracelet.name: Beautiful Bracelet
BeautifulBracelet.text: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Swift[/purple] [blue]3[/blue].
BeautifulBracelet.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]迅捷[/purple][blue]3[/blue]。

Bellows.name: Bellows
Bellows.text: The first [gold]Hand[/gold] you draw each combat is [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
Bellows.text_zh: 你在每场战斗开始时的[gold]手牌[/gold]，将被[gold]升级[/gold]。

BeltBuckle.name: Belt Buckle
BeltBuckle.text: While you have no potions, you have [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
BeltBuckle.text_zh: 当你没有药水时，你额外拥有[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

BigHat.name: Big Hat
BigHat.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Ethereal[/gold] {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BigHat.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机[gold]虚无[/gold]牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

BigMushroom.name: Big Mushroom
BigMushroom.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]. At the start of each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] fewer {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
BigMushroom.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。在每场战斗开始时，少抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

BiiigHug.name: Biiig Hug
BiiigHug.text: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], add a [gold]Soot[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
BiiigHug.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。每当你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]打乱洗牌时，将一张[gold]煤灰[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

BingBong.name: Bing Bong
BingBong.text: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], add one additional copy.
BingBong.text_zh: 每当你往[gold]牌组[/gold]中增添卡牌时，都将额外添加一张相同的牌。

BlackBlood.name: Black Blood
BlackBlood.text: At the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BlackBlood.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

BlackStar.name: Black Star
BlackStar.text: [gold]Elites[/gold] drop an additional Relic when defeated.
BlackStar.text_zh: [gold]精英[/gold]敌人在被打败时多掉落一件遗物。

BlessedAntler.name: Blessed Antler
BlessedAntler.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
BlessedAntler.text_zh: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。在战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]晕眩[/gold]放入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

BloodSoakedRose.name: Blood-Soaked Rose
BloodSoakedRose.text: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Enthralled[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
BloodSoakedRose.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[red]执迷[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。在回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

BloodVial.name: Blood Vial
BloodVial.text: At the start of each combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BloodVial.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

BoneFlute.name: Bone Flute
BoneFlute.text_zh: 每当[gold]奥斯提[/gold]攻击时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

BoneTea.name: Bone Tea
BoneTea.text: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] your starting hand.
BoneTea.text_zh: 在你接下来的[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗开始时，[gold]升级[/gold]你的初始手牌。

BookOfFiveRings.name: Book of Five Rings
BookOfFiveRings.text: Every [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} you add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BookOfFiveRings.text_zh: 你每将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

BookRepairKnife.name: Book Repair Knife
BookRepairKnife.text: Whenever a non-Minion enemy dies to [gold]Doom[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BookRepairKnife.text_zh: 每当有一名不是“爪牙”的敌人死于[gold]灾厄[/gold]时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

Bookmark.name: Bookmark
Bookmark.text: At the end of each turn, lower the cost of a random [gold]Retained[/gold] card by [blue]1[/blue] until played.
Bookmark.text_zh: 每回合结束时，随机一张被[gold]保留[/gold]的牌在被打出前的耗能减少[blue]1[/blue]。

BoomingConch.name: Booming Conch
BoomingConch.text: At the start of [gold]Elite[/gold] combats, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BoomingConch.text_zh: 在[gold]精英[/gold]战的战斗开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌并获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

BoundPhylactery.name: Bound Phylactery
BoundPhylactery.text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{Summon}[/blue].

Bread.name: Bread
Bread.text: At the start of your first turn, lose {LoseEnergy:energyIcons()}. At the start of all other turns, gain {GainEnergy:energyIcons()}.
Bread.text_zh: 在你的第一个回合开始时，失去{LoseEnergy:energyIcons()}。在其余的回合开始时，获得{GainEnergy:energyIcons()}。

BrilliantScarf.name: Brilliant Scarf
BrilliantScarf.text: The [blue]5th[/blue] card you play from your hand each turn is free.
BrilliantScarf.text_zh: 你每回合从你的手牌打出的第[blue]5[/blue]张牌可以被免费打出。

Brimstone.name: Brimstone
Brimstone.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{SelfStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and ALL enemies gain [blue]{EnemyStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Brimstone.text_zh: 在你的每个回合开始时，你获得[blue]{SelfStrength}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]，所有敌人获得[blue]{EnemyStrength}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

BronzeScales.name: Bronze Scales
BronzeScales.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue]点[gold]荆棘[/gold]。

BurningBlood.name: Burning Blood
BurningBlood.text: At the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
BurningBlood.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

BurningSticks.name: Burning Sticks
BurningSticks.text: The first time each combat you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a Skill, add a copy of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BurningSticks.text_zh: 每场战斗中你第一次[gold]消耗[/gold]技能牌时，将那张牌的复制品加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]

Byrdpip.name: Byrdpip
Byrdpip.text: Upon pickup, gain the card [gold]Byrd Swoop[/gold]. A [gold]Byrdpip[/gold] will accompany you in battles.
Byrdpip.text_zh: 拾起时，获得一张[gold]异鸟扑击[/gold]。一只[gold]幼年异鸟[/gold]会在战斗中陪伴你。

CallingBell.name: Calling Bell
CallingBell.text: Upon pickup, obtain a unique [red]Curse[/red] and [blue]{Relics}[/blue] [gold]Relics[/gold].
CallingBell.text_zh: 拾起时，获得一个独特的[red]诅咒[/red]和[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

Candelabra.name: Candelabra
Candelabra.text: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.

CaptainsWheel.name: Captain's Wheel
CaptainsWheel.text: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
CaptainsWheel.text_zh: 在你的[blue]第三[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

Cauldron.name: Cauldron
Cauldron.text_zh: 拾起时，制作[blue]{Potions}[/blue]瓶随机药水。

CentennialPuzzle.name: Centennial Puzzle
CentennialPuzzle.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
CentennialPuzzle.text_zh: 你在每场战斗中第一次损失生命值时，抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

Chandelier.name: Chandelier
Chandelier.text: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Chandelier.text_zh: 在你的[blue]第三[/blue]回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

CharonsAshes.name: Charon's Ashes
CharonsAshes.text: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
CharonsAshes.text_zh: 每当你[gold]消耗[/gold]一张牌，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

ChemicalX.name: Chemical X
ChemicalX.text: The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
ChemicalX.text_zh: 耗能为[blue]X[/blue]的牌的效果数值增加[blue]{Increase}[/blue]点。

ChoicesParadox.name: Choices Paradox
ChoicesParadox.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to the chosen card.
ChoicesParadox.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，从[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。被选中的牌获得[gold]保留[/gold]。

ChosenCheese.name: The Chosen Cheese
ChosenCheese.text: At the end of combat, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
ChosenCheese.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，获得[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点最大生命值。

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.text_zh: 拾起时，将至多[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌[gold]变化[/gold]为[gold]撕咬[/gold]。

CloakClasp.name: Cloak Clasp
CloakClasp.text: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CloakClasp.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，每有一张[gold]手牌[/gold]，就获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]

CrackedCore.name: Cracked Core
CrackedCore.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold].
CrackedCore.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{Lightning}[/blue]个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。

Crossbow.name: Crossbow
Crossbow.text: At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Attack[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
Crossbow.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，将一张随机[gold]攻击牌[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

CursedPearl.name: Cursed Pearl
CursedPearl.text_zh: 拾起时，获得一张[red]贪婪[/red]，获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。

DarkstonePeriapt.name: Darkstone Periapt
DarkstonePeriapt.text: Whenever you obtain a [red]Curse[/red], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
DarkstonePeriapt.text_zh: 每当你获得一张[red]诅咒[/red]，就将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

DataDisk.name: Data Disk
DataDisk.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{FocusPower}[/blue]点[gold]集中[/gold]。

DaughterOfTheWind.name: Daughter of the Wind
DaughterOfTheWind.text: Whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DaughterOfTheWind.text_zh: 每当你打出一张攻击牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

DelicateFrond.name: Delicate Frond
DelicateFrond.text: At the start of each combat, fill all empty potion slots with random potions.
DelicateFrond.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，用随机药水将你的空药水栏位填满。

DemonTongue.name: Demon Tongue
DemonTongue.text: The first time you lose HP on your turn, heal HP equal to the amount lost.
DemonTongue.text_zh: 每回合第一次在回合内失去生命值时，回复等量的生命值。

DiamondDiadem.name: Diamond Diadem
DiamondDiadem.text: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer cards in a turn, take half damage from enemies.
DiamondDiadem.text_zh: 如果你在本回合打出的牌少于等于[blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue]张，则受到敌人的伤害减半。

DingyRug.name: Dingy Rug
DingyRug.text: Card rewards can now contain Colorless cards.
DingyRug.text_zh: 卡牌奖励现在会包括无色牌。

DistinguishedCape.name: Distinguished Cape
DistinguishedCape.text: Upon pickup, lose [blue]9[/blue] Max HP. Add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Apparition|Apparitions}[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
DistinguishedCape.text_zh: 拾起时，失去[red]9[/red]点最大生命值。将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]灵体[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

DivineDestiny.name: Divine Destiny
DivineDestiny.text: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
DivineDestiny.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

DivineRight.name: Divine Right
DivineRight.text: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
DivineRight.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

DollysMirror.name: Dolly's Mirror
DollysMirror.text: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
DollysMirror.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张牌进行复制。

DragonFruit.name: Dragon Fruit
DragonFruit.text: Whenever you gain [gold]Gold[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
DragonFruit.text_zh: 每当你获得[gold]金币[/gold]时，提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点你的最大生命值。

DreamCatcher.name: Dream Catcher
DreamCatcher.text: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], you may add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
DreamCatcher.text_zh: 每当你[gold]休息[/gold]时，可以添加一张牌到你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

Ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
Ectoplasm.text: You can no longer gain [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
Ectoplasm.text_zh: 你不能再获得任何[gold]金币[/gold]。在回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}

ElectricShrymp.name: Electric Shrymp
ElectricShrymp.text_zh: 拾起时，选择一张技能牌为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]注能[/purple]。

EmberTea.name: Ember Tea
EmberTea.text: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
EmberTea.text_zh: 在接下来的[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

EmotionChip.name: Emotion Chip
EmotionChip.text: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.
EmotionChip.text_zh: 在每回合开始时，如果你在之前回合受到过伤害，则触发所有充能球的被动效果。

EmptyCage.name: Empty Cage
EmptyCage.text_zh: 拾起时，选择移除[gold]牌组[/gold]中的[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

EternalFeather.name: Eternal Feather
EternalFeather.text: For every {Cards:plural:card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
EternalFeather.text_zh: 你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中每有[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，当你进入[gold]休息处[/gold]时就会回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

FakeAnchor.name: Anchor???
FakeAnchor.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

FakeBloodVial.name: Blood Vial???
FakeBloodVial.text: At the start of each combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
FakeBloodVial.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

FakeLeesWaffle.name: Lee's Waffle???
FakeLeesWaffle.text: Upon pickup, heal [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your HP.
FakeLeesWaffle.text_zh: 拾起时，回复你[green]{Heal}%[/green]的生命值。

FakeMango.name: Mango???
FakeMango.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
FakeMango.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

FakeMerchantsRug.name: The Merchant's Rug???
FakeMerchantsRug.text_zh: 低劣的仿制品。没有任何作用。

FakeOrichalcum.name: Orichalcum???
FakeOrichalcum.text: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
FakeOrichalcum.text_zh: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

FakeSneckoEye.name: Snecko Eye???
FakeSneckoEye.text_zh: 每场战斗开始时获得[red]混乱[/red]效果。

FakeStrikeDummy.name: Strike Dummy???
FakeStrikeDummy.text_zh: 名字中有“打击”的卡牌造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点额外伤害。

FakeVenerableTeaSet.name: Venerable Tea Set???
FakeVenerableTeaSet.text: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
FakeVenerableTeaSet.text_zh: 到达[gold]休息处[/gold]后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

FencingManual.name: Fencing Manual
FencingManual.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Forge[/gold] [blue]{Forge}[/blue].

FestivePopper.name: Festive Popper
FestivePopper.text: At the start of each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
FestivePopper.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

Fiddle.name: Fiddle
Fiddle.text: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. You may not draw cards during your turn.
Fiddle.text_zh: 在每个回合开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。你在回合进行中不再能抽任何牌。

FishingRod.name: Fishing Rod
FishingRod.text: Every {Combats:plural:normal combat|[blue]{}[/blue] normal combats}, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
FishingRod.text_zh: 每[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场普通战斗，随机[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]牌组[/gold]中的一张牌。

ForgottenSoul.name: Forgotten Soul
ForgottenSoul.text: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
ForgottenSoul.text_zh: 每当你[gold]消耗[/gold]一张牌，随机对一名敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

FragrantMushroom.name: Fragrant Mushroom
FragrantMushroom.text: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FragrantMushroom.text_zh: 拾起时，失去[blue]{HpLoss}[/blue]点生命，然后随机[gold]升级[/gold][blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

FresnelLens.name: Fresnel Lens
FresnelLens.text: Whenever you add a card that gains [gold]Block[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Nimble[/purple] [blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue].
FresnelLens.text_zh: 每当你将一张带有[gold]格挡[/gold]的牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，为那张牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]灵巧[/purple][blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue]

FrozenEgg.name: Frozen Egg
FrozenEgg.text: Whenever you add a Power into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
FrozenEgg.text_zh: 每当你获得能力牌时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

FuneraryMask.name: Funerary Mask
FuneraryMask.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Soul|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FuneraryMask.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]灵魂[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

FurCoat.name: Fur Coat
FurCoat.text: Upon pickup, mark [blue]{Combats}[/blue] random combats. Enemies in those rooms have [blue]1[/blue] HP.
FurCoat.text_zh: 拾起时，随机标记[blue]{Combats}[/blue]处战斗。这些战斗中的敌人将只有[blue]1[/blue]点生命。

GamblingChip.name: Gambling Chip
GamblingChip.text: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
GamblingChip.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，丢弃任意张牌，然后抽相同数量张牌。

GamePiece.name: Game Piece
GamePiece.text: Whenever you play a Power, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
GamePiece.text_zh: 每当你打出能力牌时，抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

Girya.name: Girya
Girya.text: You can now gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. ([blue]3[/blue] times max)
Girya.text_zh: 你现在能在[gold]休息处[/gold]获得[gold]力量[/gold]。（最多[blue]3[/blue]次）

GlassEye.name: Glass Eye
GlassEye.text: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Common[/gold] cards, [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards, and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card.
GlassEye.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]2[/blue]组[gold]普通[/gold]、[blue]2[/blue]组[gold]罕见[/gold]、和[blue]1[/blue]组[gold]稀有[/gold]卡牌奖励。

Glitter.name: Glitter
Glitter.text_zh: 为之后的所有卡牌奖励[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]华彩[/purple]。

GnarledHammer.name: Gnarled Hammer
GnarledHammer.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择至多[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]锋利[/purple][blue]{SharpAmount:diff()}[/blue]。

GoldPlatedCables.name: Gold-Plated Cables
GoldPlatedCables.text: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
GoldPlatedCables.text_zh: 你最右侧的充能球会额外触发一次被动效果。

GoldenCompass.name: Golden Compass
GoldenCompass.text: Upon pickup, replace the [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] Map with a single special path.
GoldenCompass.text_zh: 拾起时，将第[blue]2[/blue][gold]阶段[/gold]的地图替换为一条特殊的直道。

Gorget.name: Gorget
Gorget.text: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
Gorget.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue]层[gold]覆甲[/gold]。

GremlinHorn.name: Gremlin Horn
GremlinHorn.text: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
GremlinHorn.text_zh: 每当有一名敌人死亡时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}并抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

HandDrill.name: Hand Drill
HandDrill.text: Whenever you break an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold], apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
HandDrill.text_zh: 每当你突破敌人的[gold]格挡[/gold]时，给予其[blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue]层[gold]易伤[/gold]。

HeftyTablet.name: Hefty Tablet
HeftyTablet.text: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Rare cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
HeftyTablet.text_zh: 拾起时，从[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张稀有牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]，同时将[blue]1[/blue]张[red]受伤[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

HelicalDart.name: Helical Dart
HelicalDart.text: Whenever you play a [gold]Shiv[/gold], gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
HelicalDart.text_zh: 你每打出一张[gold]小刀[/gold]，就在本回合获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

HistoryCourse.name: History Course
HistoryCourse.text: At the start of your turn, play a copy of your last played Attack or Skill.
HistoryCourse.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，打出一张你上一回合最后打出的攻击牌或技能牌的复制品。

HornCleat.name: Horn Cleat
HornCleat.text: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
HornCleat.text_zh: 在你的[blue]第二[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

IceCream.name: Ice Cream
IceCream.text: Energy is now conserved between turns.
IceCream.text_zh: 多余的能量可以留到下一回合。

InfusedCore.name: Infused Core
InfusedCore.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold]. [gold]Lightning[/gold] deals [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] additional damage.
InfusedCore.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{Lightning}[/blue]个[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球。[gold]闪电[/gold]充能球额外造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点伤害。

IntimidatingHelmet.name: Intimidating Helmet
IntimidatingHelmet.text: Whenever you play a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
IntimidatingHelmet.text_zh: 每当你打出一张耗能大于等于{Energy:energyIcons()}的牌，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

IvoryTile.name: Ivory Tile
IvoryTile.text: Whenever you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
IvoryTile.text_zh: 每当你打出一张耗能大于等于{EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()}的牌时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

JeweledMask.name: Jeweled Mask
JeweledMask.text: At the start of each combat, put a random Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this combat.
JeweledMask.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张随机能力牌从你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]，这张牌在本场战斗可以免费打出。

JewelryBox.name: Jewelry Box
JewelryBox.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]神化[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

JossPaper.name: Joss Paper
JossPaper.text: Every [blue]{ExhaustAmount}[/blue] times you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.

JuzuBracelet.name: Juzu Bracelet
JuzuBracelet.text: Regular enemy combats are no longer encountered in [gold]?[/gold] rooms.
JuzuBracelet.text_zh: 你在[gold]?[/gold]房间中不会再遭遇常规战斗。

Kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
Kaleidoscope.text: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card reward|card rewards} from other characters.
Kaleidoscope.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次来自其他角色的卡牌奖励。

Kifuda.name: Kifuda
Kifuda.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择至多[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]伶俐[/purple]。

Kunai.name: Kunai
Kunai.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
Kunai.text_zh: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

Kusarigama.name: Kusarigama
Kusarigama.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
Kusarigama.text_zh: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就随机对一名敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.text: Start each combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Lantern.text_zh: 在每场战斗的第一回合获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

LargeCapsule.name: Large Capsule
LargeCapsule.text: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]{Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add an additional [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
LargeCapsule.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件随机[gold]遗物[/gold]。额外将一对[gold]打击[/gold]和[gold]防御[/gold]，加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

LastingCandy.name: Lasting Candy
LastingCandy.text: Every other combat, your card rewards gain an additional Power.
LastingCandy.text_zh: 每两场战斗，你的卡牌奖励就会额外包含一张能力牌。

LavaLamp.name: Lava Lamp
LavaLamp.text: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all card rewards if you took no damage.
LavaLamp.text_zh: 在战斗结束时，如果你没有受到伤害，则[gold]升级[/gold]你的所有卡牌奖励。

LavaRock.name: Lava Rock
LavaRock.text_zh: 第一阶段的Boss敌人额外掉落[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

LeadPaperweight.name: Lead Paperweight
LeadPaperweight.text: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] Colorless cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
LeadPaperweight.text_zh: 拾起时，从[blue]2[/blue]张无色牌中选择[blue]1张[/blue]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

LeafyPoultice.name: Leafy Poultice
LeafyPoultice.text: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold] and lose [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
LeafyPoultice.text_zh: 拾起时，[gold]变化[/gold]你的[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]打击[/gold]和[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]防御[/gold]，然后失去[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点最大生命。

LeesWaffle.name: Lee's Waffle
LeesWaffle.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] and heal all of your HP.
LeesWaffle.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点，并回复所有生命。

LetterOpener.name: Letter Opener
LetterOpener.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Skill|Skills} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
LetterOpener.text_zh: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张技能牌，就对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

LizardTail.name: Lizard Tail
LizardTail.text: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
LizardTail.text_zh: 当你的生命值将要降低至[blue]0[/blue]或以下时，回复到最大生命值的[green]{Heal}%[/green]（仅能起效一次）。

LoomingFruit.name: Looming Fruit
LoomingFruit.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
LoomingFruit.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

LordsParasol.name: Lord's Parasol
LordsParasol.text: When you encounter the [gold]Merchant[/gold], immediately obtain EVERYTHING he sells.
LordsParasol.text_zh: 当你遇见[gold]商人[/gold]时，立刻获得他所出售的[red]所有[/red]物品。

LostCoffer.name: Lost Coffer
LostCoffer.text: Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] card reward and procure [blue]1[/blue] random potion.
LostCoffer.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]1[/blue]次卡牌奖励和[blue]1[/blue]瓶随机药水。

LostWisp.name: Lost Wisp
LostWisp.text: Whenever you play a Power, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
LostWisp.text_zh: 你每打出一张能力牌，就对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

LuckyFysh.name: Lucky Fysh
LuckyFysh.text: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
LuckyFysh.text_zh: 每当你将一张卡牌加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]时，获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。

LunarPastry.name: Lunar Pastry
LunarPastry.text: At the end of your turn, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
LunarPastry.text_zh: 在你的回合结束时，获得{Stars:starIcons()}。

Mango.name: Mango
Mango.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
Mango.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

MassiveScroll.name: Massive Scroll
MassiveScroll.text: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Multiplayer Cards[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
MassiveScroll.text_zh: 拾起时，从[blue]3[/blue]张[gold]多人游戏牌[/gold]中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

MawBank.name: Maw Bank
MawBank.text: Whenever you climb a floor, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. No longer works when you spend any [gold]Gold[/gold] at the shop.
MawBank.text_zh: 每攀爬一层楼层，就获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。一旦在商店中花费[gold]金币[/gold]就会使其失效。

MealTicket.name: Meal Ticket
MealTicket.text: Whenever you enter a shop room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
MealTicket.text_zh: 每当你进入商店房间时，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

MeatCleaver.name: Meat Cleaver
MeatCleaver.text_zh: 你可以在休息处进行[gold]烹饪[/gold]。

MeatOnTheBone.name: Meat on the Bone
MeatOnTheBone.text: If your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] at the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
MeatOnTheBone.text_zh: 如果你在战斗结束时生命值等于或低于[blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue]，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

MercuryHourglass.name: Mercury Hourglass
MercuryHourglass.text: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
MercuryHourglass.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

MiniRegent.name: Mini Regent
MiniRegent.text: The first time you spend {singleStarIcon} each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
MiniRegent.text_zh: 每回合你第一次花费{singleStarIcon}时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

MiniatureCannon.name: Miniature Cannon
MiniatureCannon.text_zh: [gold]升级[/gold]的攻击牌额外造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点伤害。

MiniatureTent.name: Miniature Tent
MiniatureTent.text: You may choose any number of options at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
MiniatureTent.text_zh: 你可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]选择任意数量的选项。

MoltenEgg.name: Molten Egg
MoltenEgg.text: Whenever you add an Attack card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
MoltenEgg.text_zh: 每当你获得[gold]攻击牌[/gold]时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

MrStruggles.name: Mr. Struggles
MrStruggles.text: At the start of your turn, deal damage equal to the turn number to ALL enemies.
MrStruggles.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成等量于当前回合数的伤害。

MummifiedHand.name: Mummified Hand
MummifiedHand.text: Whenever you play a Power, a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play that turn.
MummifiedHand.text_zh: 你每打出一张能力牌，[gold]手牌[/gold]中就有一张随机牌在这个回合可以免费打出。

MusicBox.name: Music Box
MusicBox.text: Create an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the first Attack you play each turn.
MusicBox.text_zh: 将你每回合打出的第一张攻击牌的一张[gold]虚无[/gold]复制品加入你的手牌。

MysticLighter.name: Mystic Lighter
MysticLighter.text_zh: 有[gold]附魔[/gold]的攻击牌额外造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

NeowsBones.name: Neow's Bones
NeowsBones.text: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]Neow {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]{Curses:plural:Curse|Curses}[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
NeowsBones.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件随机[gold]涅奥{Relics:plural:遗物|遗物}[/gold]。将[blue]{Curses}[/blue]张随机[red]{Curses:plural:诅咒|诅咒}[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

NeowsTalisman.name: Neow's Talisman
NeowsTalisman.text: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold].
NeowsTalisman.text_zh: 拾起时，[gold]升级[/gold]你的[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]打击[/gold]和[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]防御[/gold]。

NeowsTorment.name: Neow's Torment
NeowsTorment.text: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Neow's Fury[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
NeowsTorment.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]涅奥之怒[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

NinjaScroll.name: Ninja Scroll
NinjaScroll.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Shivs}[/blue] [gold]{Shivs:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
NinjaScroll.text_zh: 每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Shivs}[/blue]张[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Nunchaku.name: Nunchaku
Nunchaku.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.

NutritiousOyster.name: Nutritious Oyster
NutritiousOyster.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
NutritiousOyster.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

NutritiousSoup.name: Nutritious Soup
NutritiousSoup.text: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Tezcatara's Ember[/purple].
NutritiousSoup.text_zh: 拾起时，为你[gold]牌组[/gold]中的所有“[gold]打击[/gold]”[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]特兹卡塔拉的余烬[/purple]

OddlySmoothStone.name: Oddly Smooth Stone
OddlySmoothStone.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

OrangeDough.name: Orange Dough
OrangeDough.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
OrangeDough.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机无色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Orichalcum.name: Orichalcum
Orichalcum.text: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Orichalcum.text_zh: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]格挡[/gold]，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

OrnamentalFan.name: Ornamental Fan
OrnamentalFan.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
OrnamentalFan.text_zh: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，就获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

Orrery.name: Orrery
Orrery.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次卡牌奖励

PaelsBlood.name: Pael's Blood
PaelsBlood.text: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
PaelsBlood.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌

PaelsEye.name: Pael's Eye
PaelsEye.text: The first time each combat you end your turn without playing cards, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold], and take an extra turn.
PaelsEye.text_zh: 你在每场战斗中第一次没有打出任何牌就结束回合时，[gold]消耗[/gold]所有[gold]手牌[/gold]然后进行一个额外回合。

PaelsFlesh.name: Pael's Flesh
PaelsFlesh.text: Gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, and every turn after that.
PaelsFlesh.text_zh: 从你的第[blue]3[/blue]回合开始，在回合开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

PaelsGrowth.name: Pael's Growth
PaelsGrowth.text_zh: 拾起时，从[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张牌，为其[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple]。

PaelsHorn.name: Pael's Horn
PaelsHorn.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]2[/blue]张[gold]放松[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

PaelsLegion.name: Pael's Legion
PaelsLegion.text: Doubles [gold]Block[/gold] gained from a card, then goes to sleep for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
PaelsLegion.text_zh: 将你从一张卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]翻倍，然后此遗物会休眠[blue]{Turns}[/blue]回合。

PaelsTears.name: Pael's Tears
PaelsTears.text: If you end your turn with unspent {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
PaelsTears.text_zh: 如果你在拥有未花费的{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}情况下结束回合，则下个回合额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

PaelsTooth.name: Pael's Tooth

PaelsWing.name: Pael's Wing
PaelsWing.text: You may sacrifice card rewards to Pael. Every {Sacrifices:plural:sacrifice|[blue]{}[/blue] sacrifices}, obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold].
PaelsWing.text_zh: 你可以将你的卡牌奖励献祭给佩尔。每献祭[blue]{Sacrifices}[/blue]次，就能获得一件[gold]遗物[/gold]。

Pantograph.name: Pantograph
Pantograph.text: At the start of each [gold]Boss[/gold] combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.

PaperKrane.name: Paper Krane
PaperKrane.text: Enemies with [gold]Weak[/gold] deal [blue]40%[/blue] less damage to you rather than [blue]25%[/blue].
PaperKrane.text_zh: 有[gold]虚弱[/gold]状态的敌人造成的伤害降低[blue]40%[/blue]而非[blue]25%[/blue]。

PaperPhrog.name: Paper Phrog
PaperPhrog.text: Enemies with [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] take [blue]75%[/blue] more damage rather than [blue]50%[/blue].
PaperPhrog.text_zh: 有[gold]易伤[/gold]状态的敌人受到的伤害增加[blue]75%[/blue]而非[blue]50%[/blue]。

ParryingShield.name: Parrying Shield
ParryingShield.text: If you end a turn with at least [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
ParryingShield.text_zh: 如果你在回合结束时拥有至少[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]，则对随机敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

Pear.name: Pear
Pear.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
Pear.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

PenNib.name: Pen Nib
PenNib.text: Every [blue]10th[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
PenNib.text_zh: 你每打出的第[blue]10[/blue]张攻击牌将会造成双倍伤害。

Permafrost.name: Permafrost
Permafrost.text: The first time you play a Power each combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Permafrost.text_zh: 当你在战斗中第一次打出能力牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

PetrifiedToad.name: Petrified Toad
PetrifiedToad.text: At the start of each combat, procure a [gold]Potion-Shaped Rock[/gold].
PetrifiedToad.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得一瓶[gold]药水形状的石头[/gold]

PhialHolster.name: Phial Holster
PhialHolster.text: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion {PotionSlots:plural:slot|slots} and procure [blue]{Potions}[/blue] random {Potions:plural:potion|potions}.
PhialHolster.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue]个药水{PotionSlots:plural:栏位|栏位}并获得[blue]{Potions}[/blue]瓶随机{Potions:plural:药水|药水}。

PhilosophersStone.name: Philosopher's Stone
PhilosophersStone.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. ALL enemies start combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
PhilosophersStone.text_zh: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。所有敌人初始获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

PhylacteryUnbound.name: Phylactery Unbound
PhylacteryUnbound.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue].
PhylacteryUnbound.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]。在你的回合开始时，[gold]召唤[/gold][blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue]。

Planisphere.name: Planisphere
Planisphere.text: Whenever you enter a [gold]?[/gold] room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
Planisphere.text_zh: 每当你进入[gold]？[/gold]房间的时候，回复[green]{Heal}[/green]点生命。

Pocketwatch.name: Pocketwatch
Pocketwatch.text: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer {CardThreshold:plural:card|cards} during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
Pocketwatch.text_zh: 当你在本回合打出的牌少于等于[blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue]张时，则在你的下个回合开始时额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

PotionBelt.name: Potion Belt
PotionBelt.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue]个药水栏位。

PowerCell.name: Power Cell
PowerCell.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] zero-cost cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PowerCell.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张耗能为0的卡牌从你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

PrayerWheel.name: Prayer Wheel
PrayerWheel.text: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
PrayerWheel.text_zh: 普通敌人额外掉落一次卡牌奖励。

PrecariousShears.name: Precarious Shears
PrecariousShears.text: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
PrecariousShears.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌并失去[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点生命。

PreciseScissors.name: Precise Scissors
PreciseScissors.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

PreservedFog.name: Preserved Fog
PreservedFog.text: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
PreservedFog.text_zh: 拾起时，从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中移除[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。将一张[red]愚行[/red]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

PrismaticGem.name: Prismatic Gem
PrismaticGem.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Card rewards now contain cards from other colors.
PrismaticGem.text_zh: 在每个回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。卡牌奖励现在会包含其他颜色的卡牌。

PumpkinCandle.name: Pumpkin Candle
PumpkinCandle.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Extinguishes after [blue]{CombatCount}[/blue] combats. Can be [gold]Kindled[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
PumpkinCandle.text_zh: 在每个回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。这件遗物会在[blue]{CombatCount}[/blue]场战斗后熄灭。可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]为其[gold]添火[/gold]。

PunchDagger.name: Punch Dagger
PunchDagger.text_zh: 拾起时，选择一张攻击牌为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]动量[/purple][blue]{Momentum}[/blue]。

RadiantPearl.name: Radiant Pearl
RadiantPearl.text: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Luminesce|Luminesces}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
RadiantPearl.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张[gold]冷光[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

RainbowRing.name: Rainbow Ring
RainbowRing.text: The first time you play an Attack, Skill, and Power each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
RainbowRing.text_zh: 每回合，你第一次打出攻击牌、技能牌和能力牌各一张时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

RazorTooth.name: Razor Tooth
RazorTooth.text: Every time you play an Attack or Skill, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
RazorTooth.text_zh: 你打出攻击牌和技能牌时，将其在本场战斗内[gold]升级[/gold]。

RedMask.name: Red Mask
RedMask.text: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
RedMask.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，给于所有敌人[blue]{WeakPower}[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。

RedSkull.name: Red Skull
RedSkull.text: While your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold].
RedSkull.text_zh: 当你的生命值低于或等于[blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue]时，你额外获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]

RegalPillow.name: Regal Pillow
RegalPillow.text: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], heal an additional [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.

Regalite.name: Regalite
Regalite.text: Whenever you create a card, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Regalite.text_zh: 每当你生成一张牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ReptileTrinket.name: Reptile Trinket
ReptileTrinket.text: Whenever you use a potion, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
ReptileTrinket.text_zh: 当你使用药水时，在本回合获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue][gold]力量[/gold]。

RingOfTheDrake.name: Ring of the Drake
RingOfTheDrake.text: At the start of your first {Turns:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
RingOfTheDrake.text_zh: 在战斗开始时的前[blue]{Turns}[/blue]个回合，你额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

RingOfTheSnake.name: Ring of the Snake
RingOfTheSnake.text: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
RingOfTheSnake.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，额外抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

RingingTriangle.name: Ringing Triangle
RingingTriangle.text: [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] on the first turn of combat.
RingingTriangle.text_zh: 在每场战斗的第一回合[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

RippleBasin.name: Ripple Basin
RippleBasin.text: If you did not play any Attacks during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
RippleBasin.text_zh: 如果你在本回合中没有打出过攻击牌，则获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

RoyalPoison.name: Royal Poison
RoyalPoison.text: At the start of each combat, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
RoyalPoison.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，失去[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点生命。

RoyalStamp.name: Royal Stamp
RoyalStamp.text: Upon pickup, choose an Attack or Skill in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to [gold]Enchant[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
RoyalStamp.text_zh: 拾起时，从[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择一张攻击牌或技能牌，为它[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]。

RuinedHelmet.name: Ruined Helmet
RuinedHelmet.text: The first time you gain [gold]Strength[/gold] each combat, double the amount gained.
RuinedHelmet.text_zh: 你在每场战斗中第一次获得的[gold]力量[/gold]值翻倍。

RunicCapacitor.name: Runic Capacitor
RunicCapacitor.text: Start each combat with [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] additional [gold]Orb Slots[/gold].
RunicCapacitor.text_zh: 每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{Repeat}[/blue]个额外[gold]充能球栏位[/gold]。

RunicPyramid.name: Runic Pyramid
RunicPyramid.text: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
RunicPyramid.text_zh: 你在回合结束时不再自动丢弃所有[gold]手牌[/gold]。

Sai.name: Sai
Sai.text: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Sai.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ScreamingFlagon.name: Screaming Flagon
ScreamingFlagon.text: If you end your turn with no cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
ScreamingFlagon.text_zh: 如果你在回合结束时没有任何[gold]手牌[/gold]，则对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

ScrollBoxes.name: Scroll Boxes
ScrollBoxes.text: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] packs of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ScrollBoxes.text_zh: 拾起时，从[blue]2[/blue]个卡牌包中选择[blue]1[/blue]包加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

SealOfGold.name: Seal of Gold
SealOfGold.text: At the start of your turn, spend [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SealOfGold.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，花费[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]来获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

SelfFormingClay.name: Self-Forming Clay
SelfFormingClay.text: Whenever you lose HP in combat, gain [blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
SelfFormingClay.text_zh: 每当你在战斗中失去生命，就在下回合获得[blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

SereTalon.name: Sere Talon
SereTalon.text: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red] and [blue]{Wishes}[/blue] [purple]Wishes[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SereTalon.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]{Curses}[/blue]张随机[red]诅咒[/red]牌和[blue]{Wishes}[/blue]张[purple]许愿[/purple]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

Shovel.name: Shovel
Shovel.text: You can now dig at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] to obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].
Shovel.text_zh: 现在你可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]挖掘[gold]遗物[/gold]。

Shuriken.name: Shuriken
Shuriken.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
Shuriken.text_zh: 你每在同一回合内打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

SilkenTress.name: Silken Tress
SilkenTress.text: Upon pickup, lose all [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in the first card reward with [purple]Glam[/purple].
SilkenTress.text_zh: 拾起时，失去所有[gold]金币[/gold]。为第一次卡牌奖励中的所有牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]华彩[/purple]。

SilverCrucible.name: Silver Crucible
SilverCrucible.text: The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card rewards you see are [gold]Upgraded[/gold]. The first Treasure Chest you open is [red]empty[/red].
SilverCrucible.text_zh: 你遇到的前[blue]{Cards}[/blue]次卡牌奖励将是被[gold]升级[/gold]过的。你打开的第一个宝箱将是[red]空的[/red]

SlingOfCourage.name: Sling of Courage
SlingOfCourage.text_zh: 在与[gold]精英[/gold]敌人战斗时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

SmallCapsule.name: Small Capsule
SmallCapsule.text_zh: 拾起时，获得一件随机[gold]遗物[/gold]。

SneckoEye.name: Snecko Eye
SneckoEye.text: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Start each combat [red]Confused[/red].
SneckoEye.text_zh: 每回合多抽[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。每场战斗开始时获得[red]混乱[/red]效果。

SneckoSkull.name: Snecko Skull
SneckoSkull.text: Whenever you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], apply an additional [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
SneckoSkull.text_zh: 每当你给予敌人[gold]中毒[/gold]时，所给予的[gold]中毒[/gold]层数增加[blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue]层。

Sozu.name: Sozu
Sozu.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer obtain potions.
Sozu.text_zh: 你无法再获得药水。在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

SparklingRouge.name: Sparkling Rouge
SparklingRouge.text: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SparklingRouge.text_zh: 在你的第[blue]3[/blue]回合开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]和[blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

SpikedGauntlets.name: Spiked Gauntlets
SpikedGauntlets.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Powers cost [blue]1[/blue] more {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SpikedGauntlets.text_zh: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。能力牌的耗能增加[blue]1[/blue]{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

StoneCalendar.name: Stone Calendar
StoneCalendar.text: At the end of turn [blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
StoneCalendar.text_zh: 在第[blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue]回合结束时，对所有敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

StoneCracker.name: Stone Cracker
StoneCracker.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] for the rest of combat.
StoneCracker.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，在本场战斗中随机[gold]升级[/gold]你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

StoneHumidifier.name: Stone Humidifier
StoneHumidifier.text: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold] at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
StoneHumidifier.text_zh: 每当你在[gold]休息处[/gold][gold]休息[/gold]时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]点。

Storybook.name: Storybook
Storybook.text: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Brightest Flame[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Storybook.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]至亮之焰[/gold]添加到你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中。

Strawberry.name: Strawberry
Strawberry.text: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
Strawberry.text_zh: 拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]{MaxHp}[/blue]。

StrikeDummy.name: Strike Dummy
StrikeDummy.text_zh: 名字中有“打击”的卡牌造成[blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue]点额外伤害。

SturdyClamp.name: Sturdy Clamp
SturdyClamp.text_zh: 可以跨回合保留最多[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

SwordOfJade.name: Sword of Jade
SwordOfJade.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

SwordOfStone.name: Sword of Stone
SwordOfStone.text: Transforms into a powerful [gold]Relic[/gold] after defeating [blue]{Elites}[/blue] [gold]{Elites:plural:Elite|Elites}[/gold].
SwordOfStone.text_zh: 在击败[blue]{Elites}[/blue]名[gold]精英[/gold]敌人之后将变化为一件强力[gold]遗物[/gold]。

SymbioticVirus.name: Symbiotic Virus
SymbioticVirus.text: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Dark}[/blue] [gold]Dark[/gold].
SymbioticVirus.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，[gold]生成[/gold][blue]{Dark}[/blue]个[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。

TanxsWhistle.name: Tanx's Whistle
TanxsWhistle.text_zh: 拾起时，将[blue]1[/blue]张[gold]吹哨[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌组[/gold]。

TeaOfDiscourtesy.name: Tea of Discourtesy
TeaOfDiscourtesy.text: At the start of the next combat, shuffle [blue]{DazedCount}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TeaOfDiscourtesy.text_zh: 在下一场战斗开始时，将[blue]{DazedCount}[/blue]张[gold]晕眩[/gold]放入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

TheAbacus.name: The Abacus
TheAbacus.text: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
TheAbacus.text_zh: 你每次将[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]洗牌时，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

TheBoot.name: The Boot
TheBoot.text: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
TheBoot.text_zh: 每当你造成小于等于[blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue]点未被格挡的攻击伤害时，将伤害提升为[blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue]。

TheCourier.name: The Courier
TheCourier.text: The merchant no longer runs out of cards, relics, or potions and his prices are reduced by [blue]{Discount}%[/blue].
TheCourier.text_zh: 商人的卡牌、遗物和药水不再会卖光，并且所有商品打折[blue]{Discount}%[/blue]。

ThrowingAxe.name: Throwing Axe
ThrowingAxe.text: The first card you play each combat is played an extra time.
ThrowingAxe.text_zh: 你在每场战斗中打出的第一张牌会多打出一次。

Tingsha.name: Tingsha
Tingsha.text: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy for each card discarded.
Tingsha.text_zh: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就对一名随机敌人造成[blue]{Damage}[/blue]点伤害。

TinyMailbox.name: Tiny Mailbox
TinyMailbox.text_zh: 每当你[gold]休息[/gold]时，获得[blue]2[/blue]瓶随机药水。

ToastyMittens.name: Toasty Mittens
ToastyMittens.text: At the start of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
ToastyMittens.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，[gold]消耗[/gold]你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]顶部的牌并获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

Toolbox.name: Toolbox
Toolbox.text: At the start of each combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Toolbox.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，从[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张随机无色牌中选择[blue]1[/blue]张加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

TouchOfOrobas.name: Touch of Orobas
TouchOfOrobas.text: Upon pickup, replace {StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold] with [gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|your starter [gold]Relic[/gold] with an [gold]Ancient[/gold] version}.
TouchOfOrobas.text_zh: 拾起时，将{StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold]替换为[gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|你的初始[gold]遗物[/gold]替换为[gold]先古[/gold]版本}。

ToughBandages.name: Tough Bandages
ToughBandages.text: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ToughBandages.text_zh: 你每在你的回合丢弃一张牌，就获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

ToxicEgg.name: Toxic Egg
ToxicEgg.text: Whenever you add a Skill into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
ToxicEgg.text_zh: 每当你获得[gold]技能牌[/gold]时，将其[gold]升级[/gold]。

ToyBox.name: Toy Box
ToyBox.text: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] [gold]Wax {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] {Combats:plural:combat|combats}, your left-most [gold]Wax Relic[/gold] will melt away.
ToyBox.text_zh: 拾起时，获得[blue]{Relics}[/blue]件[gold]蜡制遗物[/gold]。每经过[blue]{Combats}[/blue]场战斗，你最左侧的[gold]蜡制遗物[/gold]将会融化。

TriBoomerang.name: Tri-Boomerang
TriBoomerang.text_zh: 从你的[gold]牌组[/gold]中选择[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张攻击牌。为这些牌[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]本能[/purple]。

TungstenRod.name: Tungsten Rod
TungstenRod.text: Whenever you would lose HP, lose [blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue] less.
TungstenRod.text_zh: 你每次失去生命时，减少失去的生命值[blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue]点。

TuningFork.name: Tuning Fork
TuningFork.text: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
TuningFork.text_zh: 你每打出[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张技能牌，获得[blue]{Block}[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

TwistedFunnel.name: Twisted Funnel
TwistedFunnel.text: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TwistedFunnel.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，给予所有敌人[blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue]层[gold]中毒[/gold]。

UnceasingTop.name: Unceasing Top
UnceasingTop.text: Whenever you have no cards in [gold]Hand[/gold] during your turn, draw a card.
UnceasingTop.text_zh: 在你的回合，当你没有[gold]手牌[/gold]时，抽一张牌。

UndyingSigil.name: Undying Sigil
UndyingSigil.text: Enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP deal [blue]50%[/blue] less damage.
UndyingSigil.text_zh: 当敌人的[gold]灾厄[/gold]层数大于等于其生命值时，它造成的伤害降低[blue]50%[/blue]。

UnsettlingLamp.name: Unsettling Lamp
UnsettlingLamp.text: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
UnsettlingLamp.text_zh: 你在每场战斗中第一次打出能给予敌人[gold]负面状态[/gold]的牌时，将其效果翻倍。

Vajra.name: Vajra
Vajra.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

Vambrace.name: Vambrace
Vambrace.text: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each combat, double the amount gained.
Vambrace.text_zh: 每场战斗中，你第一次从卡牌中获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]值翻倍。

VelvetChoker.name: Velvet Choker
VelvetChoker.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} per turn.
VelvetChoker.text_zh: 在每回合开始时获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。你每回合不能打出超过[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

VenerableTeaSet.name: Venerable Tea Set
VenerableTeaSet.text: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
VenerableTeaSet.text_zh: 到达[gold]休息处[/gold]后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。

VeryHotCocoa.name: Very Hot Cocoa
VeryHotCocoa.text: Start each combat with an additional [blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue].
VeryHotCocoa.text_zh: 在每场战斗的第一回合额外获得[blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue]。

VexingPuzzlebox.name: Vexing Puzzlebox
VexingPuzzlebox.text: At the start of each combat, add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
VexingPuzzlebox.text_zh: 在每场战斗开始时，将一张随机卡牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。这张牌在本回合可以免费打出。

VitruvianMinion.name: Vitruvian Minion
VitruvianMinion.text: Cards containing “Minion” deal double damage and gain double [gold]Block[/gold].
VitruvianMinion.text_zh: 名字中有“仆从”的卡牌造成双倍的伤害与[gold]格挡[/gold]。

WarHammer.name: War Hammer
WarHammer.text_zh: 每当你击败一名[gold]精英[/gold]敌人的时候，随机[gold]升级[/gold][blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌。

WhisperingEarring.name: Whispering Earring
WhisperingEarring.text: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. [red]Vakuu plays your first turn for you.[/red]
WhisperingEarring.text_zh: 在每个回合开始时，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}。[red]瓦库将接管你的第一回合。[/red]

WhiteBeastStatue.name: White Beast Statue
WhiteBeastStatue.text: Potions always appear in combat rewards.
WhiteBeastStatue.text_zh: 战斗结束后必定掉落药水。

WhiteStar.name: White Star
WhiteStar.text_zh: [gold]精英[/gold]敌人额外掉落一次[gold]稀有[/gold]卡牌奖励。

WingCharm.name: Wing Charm
WingCharm.text: A random card in each card reward is [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Swift[/purple] [blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue].
WingCharm.text_zh: 每次卡牌奖励中，都会有随机一张牌被[gold]附魔[/gold]：[purple]迅捷[/purple][blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue]。

WingedBoots.name: Winged Boots
WingedBoots.text: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] times.
WingedBoots.text_zh: 你在选择下一层的房间时有[blue]{Rooms}[/blue]次机会可以无视当前的路线。

WongosMysteryTicket.name: Wongo's Mystery Ticket
WongosMysteryTicket.text_zh: 在[blue]{RemainingCombats}[/blue]场战斗后，获得随机[blue]{Repeat}[/blue]件[gold]遗物[/gold]。
